title: 第11章 桃花酒酿惹祸端九皇子藏仇怨第12章 春雨惊蛰起惊雷小院初来客
content_zh:
“顾余生，怎么哪都有你，我看你是成心和九皇子过意不去。”陆晨刚才没有讨到好脸色，自然想把气撒在顾余生身上，“我要是你，就好好的当一条夹尾巴狗，一个人躲在无人的地方好好的苟活着，而不是出来丢人现眼。”
顾余生淡然道：“陆晨，你不就是一只好狗吗？”
“什么！”
陆晨闻言，脸一片铁青，他回头看一眼楚尘，只见这位九皇子鼻子朝着天空，显然也没把陆晨当作人。
“你再说一次！”
顾余生轻蔑一笑：“哦，你不是一条好狗！”
“你信不信我杀了你！”
陆晨捏起拳头，却不敢对顾余生下手。
青云门禁止一切私斗，违者是要直接逐出山门的。
顾余生神色不变，回应道：“不用那么急，你还有三年的时间当狗。”
“哦？你的意思是说，本殿下的狗，你想杀就能杀？”
一直摇着扇子的楚尘忽然开口，玩味的看着顾余生。
而一旁的陆晨，则是忽然像吃了一只苍蝇，神色难看，楚尘的话，就是把他当狗。
“如果咬我，我一定会杀。”
顾余生目光落在神色高傲的楚尘身上，他和这位玄龙帝国的九皇子并无交集，但是那一日入青云，此人当众辱他，以苍生为泥贬低众生，顾余生心中同样有着凌云志，不服输。
既然这是一个践踏着他人往上爬的世界，人们奉行这一套规矩，那就按这一套规矩来办。
“很好。”
楚尘嘴角露出一抹嘲弄的笑容，压根没有正视过顾余生。
“我见过太多说大话而不知天高地厚的人，不过是一条在泥泞土中蠕动的草蛇罢了，陆晨，你要攀附我玄龙王朝，就得拿出你的诚意来，三年后，我要见你咬死他，你是不是一条合格的狗，到时候自然会知晓。”
陆晨嘴角微抽，半响说不出一句话来。

“这里可不是你们耍横的地方。”
门外传来阮继的声音，他去而复返，玄龙王朝万里送来的御酒缸被阮继轻飘飘的拂放在地，他迈步进来，对那宫廷四禁卫说道：“这酒过于贵重，我们青云门只是小派，没有这样的口福，哪里来，哪里去吧。”
原本摇着扇子的楚尘动作一滞，表情一僵。
这么好的酒，也不行？
到底是何人饮酒！
天下美酒，琼浆无数，玄龙王朝都能弄到，对方的口味这么刁钻？
“把任务牌给我。”
阮继没有理会吃惊的众人，经过顾余生身边的时候，淡淡的说了一句。
“是。”
顾余生神色淡然，取出一块任务令，又把一块宗门令恭敬的递到柜台上。
阮继提笔，在身后的墙上任务牌上打了个圈，回头看一眼顾余生。
“你小子运气倒是不错，这一百宗门贡献点会发到你的宗门令里，记得妥善使用。”
“多谢前辈提醒。”
顾余生双手接过宗门令，转身发现楚尘和陆晨以及四名宫廷禁卫都在用难以置信的目光盯着他。
“等一下！”
content_en:
"Gu Yusheng, why are you everywhere? I think you are deliberately trying to make things difficult for the Ninth Prince." Lu Chen didn't get a good look just now, so he naturally wanted to take his anger out on Gu Yusheng. "If I were you, I would just be a dog with its tail between its legs and hide in a deserted place to survive alone, instead of going out and embarrassing yourself."
Gu Yusheng said calmly: "Lu Chen, aren't you just a good dog?"
"What!"
Lu Chen's face turned livid when he heard this. He looked back at Chu Chen and saw that the Ninth Prince's nose was pointing towards the sky. He obviously did not regard Lu Chen as a human being.
"Say it again!"
Gu Yusheng smiled contemptuously: "Oh, you are not a good dog!"
"Believe it or not, I will kill you!"
Lu Chen clenched his fists, but did not dare to attack Gu Yusheng.
Qingyun Gate prohibits all private fights, and those who violate the rules will be directly expelled from the gate.
Gu Yusheng's expression remained unchanged and he responded: "There's no need to be in such a hurry, you still have three years to be a dog."
"Oh? You mean, you can kill His Highness's dog if you want?"
Chu Chen, who had been shaking his fan, suddenly spoke and looked at Gu Yusheng playfully.
Lu Chen, who was on the side, suddenly looked like he had eaten a fly, his expression was ugly. In Chu Chen's words, he was treating him like a dog.
"If you bite me, I will definitely kill you."
Gu Yusheng's eyes fell on Chu Chen, who looked arrogant. He had no connection with the ninth prince of the Xuanlong Empire, but that day when he entered Qingyun, this man humiliated him in public and demeaned all living beings. Gu Yusheng also had the ambition to rise to the top and refused to admit defeat.
Since this is a world where people climb up by trampling on others and people follow this set of rules, then they should act according to this set of rules.
"Very good."
A mocking smile appeared on the corner of Chu Chen's mouth, and he didn't even look at Gu Yusheng.
"I have seen too many people who talk big words but don't know how high the sky is. They are just a grass snake squirming in the mud. Lu Chen, if you want to cling to my Xuanlong Dynasty, you have to show your sincerity. In three years, I want to see you bite him to death. I will naturally know if you are a qualified dog by then."
Lu Chen's mouth twitched slightly, and he couldn't say a word for a while.
"This is not a place for you to play tricks."
Ruan Ji's voice came from outside the door. He left and returned. The royal wine vat sent from the Xuanlong Dynasty thousands of miles away was placed lightly on the ground by Ruan Ji. He stepped in and said to the four palace guards: "This wine is too precious. Our Qingyun Sect is just a small sect. We don't have such a good reputation. Wherever it comes from, go wherever it comes from."
Chu Chen, who was originally waving his fan, froze and his expression became stiff.
Not even such a good wine?
Who is drinking?
The Xuanlong Dynasty can get all the fine wines and fine wines in the world, but the other party’s taste is so tricky?
"Give me the mission card."
Ruan Ji ignored the surprised people and said lightly when passing by Gu Yusheng.
"Yes."
Gu Yusheng looked indifferent, took out a mission order, and handed a sect order respectfully to the counter.
Ruan Ji picked up his pen, made a circle on the task card on the wall behind him, and looked back at Gu Yusheng.
"You're lucky, kid. These one hundred sect contribution points will be sent to your sect order. Remember to use it properly."
"Thank you, senior, for reminding me."
Gu Yusheng took the sect order with both hands and turned around to find Chu Chen, Lu Chen and four palace guards staring at him in disbelief.
"Wait a moment!"
